story.about: A fragile ivory origami boat sails an immense digital ocean, surviving a crushing wave to reveal AutoPromote’s power in transforming minimal input into boundless potential
story.whyCare: Founders need to see how AutoPromote turns small ideas into scalable realities — visually, emotionally, and technically — before committing resources
story.hook: A paper boat becomes an ocean. Not metaphor. Reality. And it survives the storm
story.beginning: An empty desk becomes a vast, deep blue ocean under a soft overhead light. The tiny ivory origami boat drifts calmly, framed by the immensity of the digital sea
story.development: A towering wall of water curls toward the boat — a physical threat that seems impossible to survive. The boat remains intact, untouched by the wave’s force
story.tension: The wave crashes inches from the boat, but the vessel holds. The camera pulls back to reveal the scale — the boat is a speck against the ocean’s fury
story.payoff: The wave recedes into golden calm. The boat glides forward, unharmed. The screen fades to black, then reveals the AutoPromote logo in amber-lit motion typography
story.ending: The final frame shows the AutoPromote identity card: clean, bold, and centered — no animation, no sound — just the brand name as a promise fulfilled
story.withheld: The brand name is withheld until the final resolution, reinforcing that the transformation is the core message, not the logo
amplify: Emphasize physical danger with realistic water physics
Use golden calm to contrast the storm
Make the boat feel fragile yet resilient
Avoid any hint of AI-generated clouds or fantasy
Ensure the motion card is purely typographic
Use restrained electronic score to mirror emotional arc
remove: Any mention of 'AI' or 'automation' in visuals
Customer testimonials or fictional product shots
Orchestral or vocal elements in audio
Any reference to 'factory' or 'public feature' in copy
